newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks see profit-taking in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks see profit-taking in dull trade.

text.p: Madrid stocks were lower at midsession on Friday amid a long-expected round of profit-taking after the latest record-breaking run, dealers said.
However stocks were not seen cutting back much further before gaining ground again, bolstered by the continual entry of investment fund interest, they added.
The general index shed 2.09 points, 0.33 percent, to 623.21 while the Ibex fell 45.89 points, 0.64 percent, to 7,128.52.

"The market's a bit silly today, with no clear reason to go in either direction really," said a dealer at a foreign bank. He said the U.S. public holiday was dulling trade, with smaller volume than usual.
